column1: # AFDX Virtual Link Configuration for ns-3 Simulation
# Source_ES       : End System ID that transmits this VL (1-3)
# Subscriber_ES   : End System IDs that receive this VL (semicolon-separated: "2;3" or single: "1")
# BAG_ms          : Bandwidth Allocation Gap in milliseconds (transmission period)
# Max_Frame_Size  : Maximum Ethernet frame size in bytes (64-1518)
# Min_Frame_Size  : Minimum Ethernet size in bytes (typically 64)
# - 2 Redundant Networks: Network A and Network B
# - Each VL is transmitted on BOTH networks simultaneously
# - Receivers use "First Valid Frame Wins" algorithm
# Flight Control Virtual Links (CRITICAL - Highest Priority)
# ES2 (Air Data Computer) distributes sensor readings
